summary: ColorSync is the ICC profile and colour-transform engine. BifrOSt has no ICC profile loading, no profile-to-profile transforms, no device or display profiles and no HDR path. Its only colour work is 8-bit sRGB image decoding, a Night Shift warmth tint applied to the final frame, and Light/Dark colour pairs; apps get no ColorSync-style API.

features.note: Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No transform object or profile-sequence conversion. imgdec.rs decodes JPEG and PNG to premultiplied RGBA and assumes sRGB. nv12.rs picks Rec.601 or Rec.709 YUV matrices for video only, not profile conversion.

features.apple: ColorSyncDataLayout, ColorSyncAlphaInfo, ColorSyncDataDepth (8/16/32-bit, float, premultiplied alpha)
features.note: Images are 8-bit premultiplied RGBA. No layout descriptor is exposed, and no 16-bit, float or extended-range buffers exist.

features.feature: Color profiles (ICC load, create, inspect, embed)
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/icc.rs (built in an earlier wave; no code added in b09)
features.note: Wave 6 (b09, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. The PDF reader takes ICCBased images only by component count (1 gray, 4 CMYK, else RGB) and ignores the profile bytes. Nothing parses ICC tags.

features.feature: Standard RGB profiles (sRGB, Display P3, Adobe RGB, ProPhoto)
features.note: Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Only sRGB appears as a value (accent colour, 0..1). No named working space exists and no wide-gamut display path is present.

features.apple: ColorSyncProfileCreateWithDisplayID, display VCGT transfer tables, Night Shift via the system colour pipeline
features.note: Night Shift tints the final presented frame with a warmth value from 0 to 1 and a daily schedule. This is a shell-level tint, not a profile or VCGT transfer, and it does not read the display's profile.

Wave 4 (theme-18, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. kms.rs reads the CRTC gamma_size field but does not load a gamma ramp or a profile. No device registry or custom-profile setting exists in the shell.

features.feature: Rendering intents and black point compensation
features.note: Intent and black-point choices do not exist. Night Shift is a warmth scalar, not a rendering intent.

features.feature: HDR, extended range and tone mapping
features.apple: kColorSyncExtendedRange, kColorSyncPQDerivative, kColorSyncHLGDerivative, Headroom Adaptive Gain Curve (SMPTE ST 2094-50)
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/hdr_transfer.rs, springboard/render/src/hdr_metadata.rs (built in an earlier wave; no code added in b09)
features.note: Wave 6 (b09, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. No HDR transfer function (PQ or HLG) and no HAGC metadata. nv12.rs selects Rec.601 or Rec.709 by frame height only.
CMM bundles are a plug-in model Apple's ColorSync loads at run time. BifrOSt has no equivalent, and no app-facing API would sit on top of one.

gaps: No ICC profile parser and no profile-to-profile transform engine (ColorSyncTransformCreate and ColorSyncTransformConvert have no equivalent).
No named working spaces (sRGB, Display P3, Adobe RGB) and no conversion between them, so wide-gamut images and PDF ICCBased colour are drawn as plain RGB.
No display profile or gamma-ramp path: kms.rs reads gamma_size but loads no VCGT or custom profile.
No HDR pipeline (PQ, HLG, extended range, HAGC metadata).
No app-facing colour-management API. Apps have only the Light/Dark pairs in springboard/render/src/ui.rs and the Night Shift scalar.
